subject.title: [Feature]: Show session and requester context in macOS exec approval popup

question: Which requester identity fields may the macOS exec approval popup display, and what shortening or redaction rules must apply?
rationale: The popup is a security decision surface; exposing raw session keys, channel targets, sender IDs, or thread IDs changes the local disclosure boundary.

options.title: Sanitized requester context
options.body: Display a shortened session identity and allowlisted human-readable channel, sender, and thread fields with explicit redaction rules.

options.title: Session only
options.body: Add only a trimmed or shortened Session row now and leave richer requester identity for a separately approved design.

options.title: Keep current metadata
options.body: Do not add requester context and rely on command, agent, host, and existing approval details.

recommendation.title: Sanitized requester context
recommendation.body: Display a shortened session identity and allowlisted human-readable channel, sender, and thread fields with explicit redaction rules.

likelyOwner.reason: This person already supplied maintainer-facing direction on the issue and is the strongest available routing candidate for the disclosure choice.
